payload.alt: Coordinate grid: a blue arrow runs from the origin 3 units right along the x-axis, then a red arrow goes 4 units down to the point (3, -4).
Right triangle with vertical leg 4 and horizontal leg 10; angle A is at the top vertex, opposite the side of length 10.
Box plot on a number line: minimum 59, first quartile 64.5, median 66, third quartile 70, maximum 77.
Kayaker in an orange kayak and yellow helmet paddles on a fast-flowing river with ripples, while another kayaker moves through rapids ahead.
Graph of g(x) = 4|x − 2| + 2, a V with vertex at (2, 2), and the horizontal line f(x) = 1 lying below it; the graphs never intersect.
Right triangle with legs 3 and 4 and hypotenuse 5; angle alpha is between the side of length 3 and the hypotenuse, opposite the side of length 4.
Two photos: (a) pale green crystals piled on a glass watch glass; (b) a pile of pale yellow granular powder on a white surface.
Two panels of a man pulling a girl on a sled at 1.0 m/s. She throws a snowball forward at 1.5 m/s (observer sees 2.5 m/s), then back at 1.5 m/s (observer sees -0.5 m/s).
Lewis symbols: Na plus Cl gives Na+ Cl−; Mg plus O gives Mg2+ O2−; Ca plus 2 F gives Ca2+ and two F−, metal electrons moving to the nonmetal.
Three V-shaped absolute value graphs: (a) vertex at (-1, 2) opening up; (b) vertex at (2, 0) opening up; (c) vertex at (1, 3) opening down, x-intercepts -2 and 4.
Spectrum from radio waves at low frequency through microwaves, infrared, a narrow visible band near 10^15 Hz, ultraviolet, X rays to gamma rays.
Five d orbitals in an octahedral ligand field: dx2−y2 and dz2 lobes point at ligands on the axes; dxy, dxz, dyz lobes point between the axes.
X-ray tube in a vacuum bulb: electrons from a heated filament are accelerated by a high-voltage source V into an angled metal target, which emits X rays.
Three strings of original length L0 hang from a bar, each pulled by weight w; stretch delta L is largest for thin nylon, smaller for thick nylon, tiny for steel.
Graph of an inverted V-shaped absolute value function with vertex at (1.25, 3), crossing the x-axis at -0.25 and 2.75; it is below the x-axis outside those points.
Graph of absolute value V shapes: red dashed V at origin with ratio 2/1, blue solid V with vertex (3, -2) and ratio 1/1, green dashed V also at (3, -2).
Graphs of absolute value functions: y = |x| shifts right 3, stretches by 2, then shifts up 4, moving the vertex from (0, 0) to (3, 4).
Right triangle with legs 10 (vertical) and 8 (horizontal); angle A is at the bottom right, opposite the side of length 10.
Richard Smalley, bald with a white beard, in a patterned jacket and tie, speaking at a podium with a microphone and laptop.
Bar chart of pH ranges for 19 indicators, from crystal violet (0 to 1.8) to alizarin yellow R (10 to 12); phenolphthalein turns clear to pink from 8 to 10.
Table of sodium through argon with configurations [Ne]3s1 to [Ne]3s2 3p6; Lewis symbols show dots rising from 1 for Na to 8 for Ar.
Cube of volume V0 with face area A, equal forces F pushing inward on all six faces, shrinking it to a dashed inner cube of volume V0 minus delta V.
V-shaped absolute value graph of f with vertex near (-0.25, -7), crossing the x-axis at (-2, 0) and (1.5, 0), labeled where f(x) = 0.
Energy diagram: dz2 and dx2−y2 (eg) boxes sit above dxy, dxz, dyz (t2g) boxes, separated by the octahedral splitting energy delta oct.
Number line centered at 5 with arrows extending 4 units left and 4 units right, showing all points within distance 4 of 5, from 1 to 9.
Two panels: a ship moving toward Earth at v = 0.50c fires a canister toward Earth at u′ = 0.75c (left) or away from Earth at u′ = −0.75c (right).
Unit circle with a 30-60-90 right triangle: angle pi/3 at the origin, pi/6 at top; sides s, square root of 3 times s, and hypotenuse 2s.
Right triangle with legs 7 and 24 and hypotenuse 25; angle t is at the far end of the 24 leg, opposite the side of length 7.
Complex plane axes: a horizontal real axis crossed at the origin by a vertical imaginary axis, both with arrows at each end.
Box plot: minimum 10, first quartile 15, median 95, third quartile 490, maximum 790; the data are strongly skewed right.
Graph of X-ray intensity I versus frequency f: a broad hump with two sharp peaks near its top, dropping to zero at f max, where qV equals h f max.
Right triangle formed by a tree and the ground: the base is 30 feet from the tree, and the angle of elevation to the treetop is 57 degrees.
Unit circle quadrant with a right triangle: hypotenuse 1 at angle t from the x-axis to point (x, y), horizontal leg x, vertical leg y.
Rainbow arrows hitting black, white and yellow surfaces; color wheel labeled 400 to 800 nm; test tube where white light enters and red and orange are removed.
Two box plots on a 20 to 100 scale. Top: 33 to 100, box 53 to 82, median 74. Bottom: 25 to 100, narrow box 79 to 90, median 81, long left whisker.
Probability histogram of P(X=x) for x = 0 to 4: about 0.01, 0.19, 0.45, 0.30, 0.04, peaking at x = 2.
Graph of force F versus elongation delta L: force rises slowly, then steeply and linearly, peaks, then drops and levels off as the tendon fails.
Car moving right at speed v emits headlight light at speed c; the driver measures u prime equals c and a man on the sidewalk ahead also measures u equals c.
View from a gondola: another gondola hangs from a sloping cable above a snowy slope, with towers carrying the cable up a misty mountain.
Lewis structures: P bonded to five Cl atoms and S bonded to six F atoms by single bonds, each halogen with three lone pairs; no lone pairs on P or S.
Two rods of original length L0 and cross-section area A: (a) outward forces F at both ends lengthen it by delta L; (b) inward forces F shorten it by delta L.
Complex plane plotting minus 2 plus 3i: a blue arrow goes 2 units left along the real axis, then a red arrow goes 3 units up to the point.
Weathered circus poster peeling off a door; sun has bleached most colours, leaving it mainly pale blue and white with black text.
Right triangle with angle t at the left vertex: adjacent side 56, opposite side 33, hypotenuse 65.
Right triangle with angle t at the left vertex: adjacent side along the bottom, opposite side on the right, hypotenuse slanting across the top.
Andromeda Galaxy, a tilted spiral galaxy with a bright core and dark dust lanes, with a small companion galaxy against a dense field of stars.
Graph of a V-shaped absolute value function with vertex at (3, negative 2), x-intercepts at 2 and 4, passing through (0, 4) and (5, 2).
Four ligands at alternate corners of a cube around a central metal, with a d orbital's four lobes lying between the x and z axes, pointing near the ligands.
Graph of y equals absolute value of x: a V shape with its vertex at the origin, rising with slope 1 to the right and slope negative 1 to the left.
Right triangle with legs 15 and 8 and hypotenuse 17; angle alpha is at the left vertex, between the side of 15 and the hypotenuse.
Right triangle with acute angles alpha and beta; labels state sin alpha = cos beta and sin beta = cos alpha.
Nail of diameter 1.50 mm sticks 5.00 mm out of the wall; downward weight w at the picture and upward w from the wall shear it, deflecting it 1.80 micrometers.
Box plot on a 1 to 7 number line: box from 1 to 5 with no left whisker, so minimum equals Q1 at 1; right whisker reaches maximum 7.
Two pH vs NaOH volume curves: strong acid starts near pH 1, weak acid near pH 3 with a buffer plateau; both jump sharply at 25 mL, leveling near 12.5.
Three capped glass vials of solution side by side: the left is violet-blue, the center is orange-yellow, and the right is red.
Two spaceships moving at 0.500c, one toward Earth and one away, each emitting laser light forward; the light travels at c in both cases.
X-ray of a hand: finger and palm bones show as gray shapes inside faint soft tissue, while a ring and metal objects appear solid black.
Tower with a line of sight to a ground point: angle of depression at the top, below the horizontal, equals angle of elevation at the ground.
Two right triangles in unit circles: angles pi/3 and pi/6 with sides s, root 3 s, 2s; angles pi/4 and pi/4 with legs s and hypotenuse root 2 s.
Bookshelf of height L0 pushed right at the top and left at the bottom by forces F; dashed outline shows it leaning into a parallelogram, top shifted by delta x.
Box plot on a number line from 1 to 11.5: minimum 1, first quartile 2, median 7, third quartile 9, maximum 11.5.
Graph of transformations: dashed red V at the origin shifts to a dashed green V at vertex (3, -2), then stretches into a steeper solid blue V.
Two photos: (a) an off-white, chalky powder in a clear glass dish; (b) a pile of vivid blue crystalline powder on a white surface.
Orbital energy diagram: free Fe2+ has 4 unpaired d electrons; [Fe(H2O)6]2+ keeps 4 unpaired (t2g 4, eg 2); [Fe(CN)6]4− pairs all 6 in t2g, empty eg.
Graph of V-shaped f with vertex at (5, 0) and horizontal line g at y = 4, meeting at x = 1 and x = 9; f is at or below g for x from 1 to 9.
Right triangle with a 30 degree angle at the top vertex. Side a is adjacent to it, the side of length 7 is opposite it, and c is the hypotenuse.
Delta L versus F: straight line from origin, then curve leveling off through the elastic region, then rising steeply in permanent deformation up to fracture.
pH vs mL NaOH: HCl starts near pH 1, weak acid near 3; both jump at 25 mL, equivalence pH 7.00 and 8.72. Only phenolphthalein's 8.4–10 range fits both.
Right triangle with acute angles alpha and beta. The leg adjacent to alpha is opposite beta, the leg adjacent to beta is opposite alpha; hypotenuse is longest.
